The first event on the afternoon's programme was the Surrey County 7 miles walk championship, and Harry Churcher scored a good win from young Brian Shepherd in 54 min. 20 secs.

Bob McMullen, 10th, led the "A" team home followed by Syd James, 11th, George Checkley.14th, and Eric Hall 20th, the next three places being filled by Phillips, Brian Shepherd (second claim) and Hugh McGreechan

The event which added to our prestige the most was the two miles walk between Belgrave and the Police in which we filled all the leading positions with Brian Shepherd, Syd James and E.
